Description: Use Permit #ZP2026-0007 to construct a new 6-story (66’-3”), 45-unit housing development, with 34,526-square-feet of new residential use. The project includes a removal of existing non-landmarked group living residential structure. 15% (4 units) of the base units will be affordable to very low-income residents, and 11% (3 units) of the base units will be affordable to low-income and moderate-income residents, making the project eligible for an 85% density bonus, waivers, and up to 3 concessions as a state density bonus law development per CA Govt Code 65915.
